summary: Eight findings; ten independent probes fail. Existing project checks pass (197 backend, 6 frontend). TAR-013 and TAR-015 reopened; TAR-014 remains Done. M3 approval unchanged. No commits.

findings.explanation: Aurora's application role can SET ROLE to the bootstrap superuser, bypassing client isolation. Confirmed live in a rolled-back transaction.
Aurora uses the RabbitMQ administrator credential, which can restore access to Southgrid despite revoked vhost permissions.
Both clients share market and callback credentials, allowing cross-client authentication.
Non-409 HTTP failures exhaust attempts without transitioning to FAILED; sweep then excludes the draft permanently.
Uncertain submissions are resubmitted without polling first, contrary to decision 005 recovery requirements.
Unlocked expiry saves and missing state rechecks allow sweep to overwrite completed callbacks with reconciling or failed states.
Malformed callback fields can complete workflows, and acknowledgement/reconciliation correlations are not validated.
Outbox delivery ignores topic and payload and lacks the required versioned, validated core contract. Invalid envelopes still register supply points.

checks.command: Read-only database SET ROLE and RabbitMQ user inspection

verification_gaps: No process-kill/restart or billing-under-market-outage campaign performed.
Fresh-volume deployment, image-digest comparison, browser verification and hosted CI were not performed.
